sourceRefs.locator: Opening project description. Nahua elders, authors and artists and Bernardino de Sahagún, parallel Nahuatl/Spanish text, 12 books, completion in 1577 at the Imperial Colegio de la Santa Cruz in Tlatelolco.
Discussion of the creation of the manuscript and its Nahua authors, including the four named grammarians, rector Martín Jacobita of Tlatelolco, and Antonio Valeriano of Azcapotzalco.
Tenochtitlan/Tlatelolco map, circa 1500; slide headed Images of artists/scribes (tlahcuilohqueh), Florentine Codex, Book 11 and the lists of named grammarians and scribes.
Q2477757, coordinate location (P625). General orientation at the named site.
